people.role: Keeper of the red feathers of the dead at the Wutong Court (Hall of Rites)
people.appearance: Sews a red feather into her hem for every soul she keeps.
people.backstory: Keeps one red feather for each of the palace's dead in the Wutong Court and sews the newest in herself; Thương Tẫn Quy (thuong_tan_quy) brings her the names down from the long road.

ties.note: master of the Hall of Rites

tree.intent: Wood music that steadies the hall.

people.role: Tender of the great wutong at the Wutong Court
people.appearance: A counting-string round his wrist, knotted to a leaf-count he will not say.
people.backstory: Climbs the great wutong each month to count the fallen leaves for Vu Ngô Đồng (vu_ngo_dong), and has begun to count them twice; he has not told An Thúy Vũ (an_thuy_vu) the number.

ties.note: bird keeper of the Wutong Court

tree.intent: Wood that feeds a tree and a fire.

people.role: Holds the gate of the Wutong Court under Nhậm Cương Thủ
people.appearance: The wine-flush climbs from his collar whenever the head is mentioned.
people.backstory: One of the few ridge children born with Fire, like his captain Nhậm Cương Thủ (nham_cuong_thu), he says when he has drunk that the head ran from the Tower in 1162; Hách Chu Lăng (hach_chu_lang), who trained him, has told him twice to stop.

ties.note: trained him at the vein fort

tree.intent: A Metal guard lit by Fire.

people.role: Ash-born fan duelist of the Hall of Righteousness
people.appearance: Two stair-challenge burns, one on each shoulder, which he calls medals.
people.backstory: Ash-born and loud about it, he has challenged Đằng Phi Diễm (dang_phi_diem) for the top step of the Fire Court's stair three times and lost three times, each time a little closer. He had a rival's practice fan soaked in oil and lit mid-bout to see the rival run; Địch Tiểu Chước (dich_tieu_chuoc) held the boy's hands under the well.

ties.note: fan master of the inner gate
holds the top step of the stair
practises the fan forms before dawn on the Fire Court's stair

people.role: Veteran of the Cinnabar Vein War in the Hall of Righteousness
people.appearance: Grey in his beard at forty, and a dead woman's fan-tassel sewn to his sleeve.
people.backstory: Was on Đan Sơn Mạch when Cố Dạ Lan killed Dụ Đan Huỳnh (du_dan_huynh) in 1154 (N-phuong_minh-10) and carried her body down without its fan; he wants the war Sử Hoành Dực (su_hoanh_duc) wants. He sent the junior who lost her fan back up the pass alone in the dark three times; the boy came back frostbitten, without it.

ties.note: fell on Đan Sơn Mạch in 1154; he carried her down

tree.intent: Fire fans for the line of battle.

people.role: Helmsman of the palace fleet's flagship
people.appearance: The ear notched by a pirate's grapple turns to every shout.
people.backstory: Steers the flagship and keeps a list of every pirate keel sighted since the Purge (C152); Can Hải Trì (can_hai_tri) says the list is longer than the fleet.

ties.note: deck hand of the palace fleet

tree.intent: Water under Fire, for the sea.

people.role: Night watch of the vein fort at Đan Sơn Mạch
people.appearance: A thunder-charm in her left ear, tilted always toward the ridge.
people.backstory: Hách Chu Lăng's (hach_chu_lang) niece, she stands the night watch facing Thính Vũ's ridge and has learned to tell rain from thunder by ear, which no one in the palace values. She calls thunder when it is rain so the wall is cleared, and rain when she wants her bed.

tree.intent: Fire Banner charges on a wall.

people.role: Rides the famine roads with the granary carts of the Hall of Benevolence
people.appearance: Blushes to the neck at every thank-you.
people.backstory: Opened the granary carts on the southern roads in a bad year and has been thanked in ceremony by eleven villages; he dislikes ceremonies, and Điền Phong Niên (dien_phong_nien) makes him attend them.

ties.note: master of the Hall of Benevolence
the healer who rides with him
granary cart hand of the Hall of Benevolence
keeps the audience roll of the Hall of Virtue

tree.intent: Fire for a body that carries.

people.role: Grinds cinnabar at the furnace on Chu Sa Tuyền
people.appearance: Cinnabar-red dust in the part of her hair.
people.backstory: Grinds cinnabar for Kế Chu Sa (ke_chu_sa) and wants Kiều Đan Lô's (kieu_dan_lo) place at the furnace mouth; she has the better hands, and he has the older seat. She skims a measure of cinnabar from each grinding for her own pills, so Kiều's batches run short and Kiều takes the blame.

ties.note: watches the furnace fire through the night at Chu Sa Tuyền

people.role: Counts the vassals' tribute for the Hall of Trust
people.appearance: Two tally-sticks behind his ears, one for coin and one for rice.
people.backstory: Counts the tribute the six vassals bring at New Year; Phần Vũ Đường's has come short more than once, and he has written it down each time for Vưu Cẩm Thư (vuu_cam_thu). He entered Phần Vũ's tribute short one year because its carter did not bow, and Đới Liệt Cương (doi_liet_cuong) was dunned for the difference.

ties.note: master of the Hall of Trust
keeps the Hall of Spoils' inventory

people.role: Tends the Ash Seat's coals at the Nest between breakthroughs
people.appearance: Looks at the sky before speaking, and says nothing if it is cloudy.
people.backstory: Sweeps the vent's lip after each breakthrough and found his nephew Dư Tân Hỏa (du_tan_hoa) the Nest's errand post; he has noticed the boy has money lately.

people.role: Keeps the audience roll of the Hall of Virtue
people.appearance: Gold thread at his cuff, never the same colour twice.
people.backstory: Sets the order in which petitioners see the head by whichever bribe is largest that morning, and has been bribed in every order he set; he gives the money to the granaries and says he kept his own order. Khổng Tế Dân (khong_te_dan) waited three days behind a smaller bribe.

ties.note: clerk of the Hall of Virtue
takes the bribes to the granaries

people.role: Tunes the flutes sold at Thiều Âm Thị
people.appearance: Plays a note in her head before she answers.
people.backstory: Plays each flute before Thiều Âm Thị sells it; Lộ Văn Khánh (lo_van_khanh) sends her home early on the nights he walks to Kích Khánh Đường, and she has stopped asking why.

ties.note: strings the qin sold at Thiều Âm Thị
shop boy of the music market

people.role: Gathers the vent birds' down for the Feather Kindling
people.appearance: Knits bracelets of chrysanthemum fluff and gives them away.
people.backstory: The Cúc Viên Thôn child of her generation (A303), she saves the softest down for whoever came from her village; this year that is Thành Dã Cúc (thanh_da_cuc).

ties.note: the Hall of Benevolence runs the outer gate
new outer disciple from Tang Âm Thôn

people.role: Rides the western march with the Wutong Court's hawks
people.appearance: A spyglass through his belt like a dagger.
people.backstory: Has watched Thính Vũ's new seat rise on Thần Cổ Phong since 1166 from the western march; he reports to Vu Ngô Đồng (vu_ngo_dong), who sends the reports on to the Fire Court a day late.

ties.note: captain of the Wutong Court's guard

tree.intent: Metal sight and a hawk's dive.

people.role: Feeds the spirit birds of the Wutong Court
people.appearance: A whistle always curled in her cheek, so that she lisps.
people.backstory: A bird keeper's daughter from Bách Vũ Các who whistles the birds down for Ổ Linh Tước (o_linh_tuoc) and has named every one of them.

people.role: Cuts the bamboo shoots that feed the Wutong Court
people.appearance: Eight small scorch-lines on the left forearm, one per sitting.
people.backstory: Sat the Feather Kindling eight times; then Vu Ngô Đồng (vu_ngo_dong) told him the tree needs Wood more than the palace needs Fire, and he has not sat it since. He tells Vu so, and sits it in secret each year in the place of Thành Dã Cúc (thanh_da_cuc), who is told the roll is full.

ties.note: bird keeper of the Wutong Court
the elder who spoke to him

people.role: Plays the second part of the dawn flute at the Wutong Court
people.appearance: His eyes shut when he blows.
people.backstory: Plays a half beat behind Bạc Địch Thanh (bac_dich_thanh) on purpose; he says the dawn call sounds wider with two.

ties.note: flautist of the Hall of Rites

people.role: Carries the urns up the long road to Quy Vũ Lĩnh
people.appearance: A string of small urn-stoppers at his throat, clicking when he nods.
people.backstory: Has scattered more of the palace's dead from the wutong grove than any living disciple, walking behind Thương Tẫn Quy (thuong_tan_quy); he asks each urn its name on the road.

people.role: Water carrier (tạp dịch) of the Wutong Court's kitchens
people.appearance: Walks with the stoop of a yoke he put down years ago.
people.backstory: Has hauled water to the Wutong Court's kitchens since before the head's court went down to the Fire Court; he still sets ninety bowls at New Year and clears forty.
people.exception: servant (tạp dịch): ridge-born, an Earth root with no Fire or Wood

people.role: Sword in the Wutong Court's guard, admitted on Wood
people.appearance: Goes grey and silent when the Feather Kindling is named, and leaves the room.
people.backstory: A Lưu Kim miner's daughter in Nhậm Cương Thủ's (nham_cuong_thu) guard, admitted on Wood 32 and kept for her sword arm; she will never pass the Feather Kindling and does not mean to try. She cannot bear to be near the sitting.

people.role: Ash-born inner disciple of the fan forms
people.appearance: Rolls her sleeves to hide a worn cuff under a too-bright tassel.
people.backstory: Passed the Feather Kindling at nineteen and has waited four years for Foundation; Cảnh Vũ Ca (canh_vu_ca) says she fans too hard. She has told her master she passed her Foundation sitting; she has not, and her master has put her name on the Hall's list on that word.

people.role: Runner of the Hall of Righteousness
people.appearance: Mouth half open, ready for the next word.
people.backstory: Runs the Hall's orders across the Fire Court for Đái Liệt Dương (dai_liet_duong) word for word, including, once, a curse Sử Hoành Dực (su_hoanh_duc) had not meant to be carried.

ties.note: adjutant of the Hall of Righteousness

people.role: New outer disciple from Tang Âm Thôn
people.appearance: Two burnt feather-ends in her hair, kept as charms.
people.backstory: Came down from Tang Âm with the spring recruiters and has burned two down feathers already; Liêu Nhung Hỏa (lieu_nhung_hoa) keeps giving her more.

ties.note: gathers the down for the Kindling

people.role: Granary cart hand of the Hall of Benevolence
people.appearance: Straw in his hair, even at the table.
people.backstory: A Thủy Điền rice farmer's son who rides the granary carts with Khổng Tế Dân (khong_te_dan) and sleeps under them.

people.role: Copies petitions in the Hall of Virtue
people.appearance: Ink-blue lips from licking her pen.
people.backstory: Copies the petitions that reach the Hall of Virtue for Thì Văn Bính (thi_van_binh) and will sit the Feather Kindling this year on Fire 42, which is not quite enough. She adds her own name to the petitions she thinks best; Dương Hộ Thụ's (duong_ho_thu) petition for the grove count went up as hers.

ties.note: clerk of the Hall of Virtue

people.role: Deck hand of the palace fleet
people.appearance: Walks with a sailor's roll even on dry land.
people.backstory: Climbs the flagship's mast for Mã Phá Lãng (ma_pha_lang) and spends his pay in Thạch Cơ's harbour; Trạm Ba Thanh (tram_ba_thanh) drags him back aboard.

people.role: Diver of the palace fleet
people.appearance: Holds a drowned-bell pendant in her teeth when she dives.
people.backstory: Born at Âu Lộ on the jungle coast, she dives for Ô Trầm Châu (o_tram_chau) and can hold her breath longer than he can, which he resents.

people.role: The admiral's grandson, put to the oars
people.appearance: Chin held high over raw oar-blisters.
people.backstory: Phàn Vọng Hải's (phan_vong_hai) grandson, put to the oars by his grandfather's order like any deck hand; Can Hải Trì (can_hai_tri) has been told to work him harder than the rest, and does. He had Giang Triều Sinh (giang_trieu_sinh) lashed to the oar until he fainted, and laughed.

people.role: Cinnabar miner's son at the vein fort
people.appearance: Rock-grey skin, and he sleeps with one hand on the wall.
people.backstory: Grew up in the cinnabar shafts of Đan Sa Quật and walls the vein fort for Mông Chu Tiêu (mong_chu_tieu); he has never seen a Thính Vũ sword and wants to.

people.role: Signal girl of the vein fort
people.appearance: Banner dye on her fingertips, red on one hand and black on the other.
people.backstory: Sử Niệm Huỳnh (su_niem_huynh) has taught her to read the Pivot's and the Tower's banners across the vein, and to wish, as her teacher does, that they never meant war.

people.role: Herb girl for the healers of Hoàng Vân Thành
people.appearance: Her nose wrinkles at every smell, even good ones.
people.backstory: Gathers and dries the healers' herbs for Từ Cam Tuyền (tu_cam_tuyen) and knows the fevers of the rice plain by smell.

ties.note: healer of the Hall of Benevolence

people.role: Granary hand at Hoàng Vân Thành for fifty years
people.appearance: Knocks on every wall he passes, listening.
people.backstory: Has turned the grain in the Hoàng Vân granaries for half a century under Cốc Thu Thành (coc_thu_thanh) and can tell a damp bin by knocking on it.

people.role: Strings the qin sold at Thiều Âm Thị
people.appearance: Silk-string grooves in her fingertips, one for each string.
people.backstory: A luthier's daughter from Thiều Âm Thị who strings the qin for Hàn Ngọc Tiêu (han_ngoc_tieu) and tunes them by the dawn flute.

people.role: Shop boy of the music market
people.appearance: Flute-reeds tucked behind each ear.
people.backstory: Sweeps Hàn Ngọc Tiêu's (han_ngoc_tieu) shop at Thiều Âm Thị and plays the stock when she is out; he sleeps behind the counter, and she lost a buyer to the open door.

people.role: Watches the furnace fire through the night at Chu Sa Tuyền
people.appearance: Eyelids red from the furnace glare.
people.backstory: Sits up with the furnace through the night for Lữ Chu Hống (lu_chu_hong) and wakes her at the colour change; she pays him in cracked pills.

people.role: Carries herbs up to the furnace
people.appearance: Smells of cassia before she arrives.
people.backstory: A Quế Viên girl who carries cassia and herbs up to the furnace for Kiều Đan Lô (kieu_dan_lo), and is on his side against Lữ Chu Hống (lu_chu_hong) without being asked.

people.role: Rings the bell at the Ash Seat
people.appearance: A bronze bell at her wrist, silenced by a pinch of cloth.
people.backstory: Rings the bronze bell on the vent's lip when an elder sits the Ash Seat and again when they rise; she has rung the second bell eleven times and the third, for a death, twice.

people.role: Cook (tạp dịch) of the Fire Court's kitchens
people.appearance: A ladle burn up the back of one hand, which she shows off like a medal.
people.backstory: Cooks the Fire Court's rice beside Bào Lạc Hải (bao_lac_hai) and seats guests by her fancy; she put the envoy Bình Viễn Khách's (binh_vien_khach) clerk at the door in sleet, and remembers him by name.
people.exception: servant (tạp dịch): an Earth root with no Fire or Wood

people.role: Hùng Diễm Nhi's cousin at the Fire Court; writes Tào Tẫn Kiên what she does
people.appearance: Smiles a beat late, after he has checked who is watching.
people.backstory: Hùng Diễm Nhi's (hung_diem_nhi) cousin, sent to the palace's outer gate from Phần Vũ Đường in 1197. He rides her where she needs to go, and writes Tào Tẫn Kiên (tao_tan_kien) what she does there, for a place Tào has promised him in the hall.

ties.note: his cousin; he rides for her and reports on her
the first elder he writes to, who has promised him a place in the hall

people.changed: pass B (fixB-1, 2026-11-25): no longer a second surety (read-great-2 #9); Tào's informer; traits Loyal -> Greedy; duplicate master tie merged

people.role: Miêu Trúc Sinh's first pupil
people.appearance: Silver-fine hair already at twenty-six, tied in a bamboo ring.
people.backstory: Miêu Trúc Sinh (mieu_truc_sinh) took her the year he passed the Feather Kindling at last, and tells her she has seventy years if she needs them.

tree.intent: Wood that will one day burn.

people.role: Outer disciple of the Hall of Rites at the Wutong Court
people.appearance: Whistles through the gap between her front teeth.
people.backstory: From Bạc Địch Thanh's (bac_dich_thanh) own village of Hà Loan; he heard her whistle at the spring fair and asked for her.

ties.note: flautist of the Hall of Rites

people.role: Rides with the palace's envoy to the vassals
people.appearance: Bows a hand's width deeper than his rank requires.
people.backstory: Born at Lễ Tuyền Phái among the sweet spring's keepers, he rides with Bình Viễn Khách (binh_vien_khach) to the vassals and carries the palace's gifts in both hands. He bows deep to every host and tells each that the vassal across the hall spoke ill of them, which is why her circuit is so quarrelsome.

people.role: Practises the fan forms before dawn on the Fire Court's stair
people.appearance: A cheek scar from a fan-edge, traced when she lies.
people.backstory: Watches Sầm Liệt Dực's (sam_liet_duc) challenges on the stair and tells him afterwards where he lost; he asks her before he asks his master. She tells his rivals where he lost as well.

people.role: Wood girl of the Wutong Court, Kha Thanh Miêu's bunk-mate
people.appearance: Pauses under the great tree and looks up, every time.
people.backstory: Came from Trúc Thực Viên with Kha Thanh Miêu (kha_thanh_mieu) and sleeps beside her; she thinks the great wutong sheds fewer leaves on her friend's side of the court, and has told no one, since she cannot prove it.
